'''Heguang''' is an NPC in [[Huanglong]]. He guards the west gateway of Jinzhou with [[Qingning]].
__NOTOC__
==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Heguang:''' Two thousand and ninety-eight, two thousand and ninety-nine... Hey, it's you, number three thousand! Congrats on being our three thousandth visitor to Jinzhou today!

:'''Heguang:''' Nice to see you again! Got any fun stories to share this time?

:'''Heguang:''' Everyone's been saying, "Make the most of the land, and the people's wisdom will follow." Jinzhou's feats of construction have been the talk of the town!
{{Dialogue End}}
